entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That's horrible...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It's that same fiancé guy, right? You know[n]what's going to happen...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Based on what Haru just told us, she'll be[n]taken to his house on October 11th...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That means our deadline is the 10th.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But if we trigger a change of heart in[n]your father, he'll definitely be taken[n]by the police.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The label of a "criminal's daughter" will[n]forever stick with you.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Your current living situation may change[n]as well.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: If I accept a happiness based on the[n]misfortune of others, I'll be no better[n]than my father.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: And to be honest...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I've actually left a request on the[n]Phantom Aficionado Website before.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: She did so around the time we were[n]mulling over who to target next.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But... the Phantom Thieves didn't make[n]a move...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: That's when I met Mona-chan. I thought[n]it was fate.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I made my decision then. If the Phantom[n]Thieves wouldn't act, I'd do it myself...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The mental shutdowns, Treasure,[n]and finally, the change of heart...[n]Our interests have come together.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Would you cooperate with us now?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Of course. I should be the one cordially[n]asking to be allowed on the team.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: From here on, we may be going up[n]against the culprit behind those mental[n]shutdown occurrences.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This'll be different from our training in[n]Mementos. You better brace yourselves.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You're suddenly lecturin' us?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You're too naïve! Haru's barely a hair[n]better than an amateur.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: She's awakened to her powers, but it's[n]weak... Even her Persona's lacking a[n]solid form at the moment.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Weak?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Really?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: She can transform at the very least, but[n]to be frank, she may slow us down. A lot.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I'm sorry for causing such trouble...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Nah, don't worry about it. It's actually[n]convenient for us to target that CEO.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Check out this news blog.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: There's a lot of negative comments[n]in regard to the Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: "The names of obvious criminals have[n]come up, so why haven't the Phantom[n]Thieves acted yet!?"

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: The way they're getting heated is on[n]a different level.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Don't forget about the intel on the mental[n]shutdown cases, all right?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Of course! We'll get 'em both!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: October... uhh, 10th, was it? We're gonna[n]change Okumura's heart by then!
